methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $35.4B bookings in FY16; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2016 10-K names off-shore providers, 'in lower-cost locations, particularly in India, that offer services globally that are similar to the services and solutions we offer', among its competitors and says competitors 'may be willing, at times, to price contracts lower than us' and 'may also offer more aggressive contractual terms', and that its own delivery network 'is increasingly concentrated in India and the Philippines', while its own Global Delivery Network grew to about 285,000 people. The stock trades at 22.1x FY17E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

Live: Accenture's own FY2016 10-K says 'Examples of areas of significant change include digital-, cloud- and security-related offerings, which are continually evolving as developments such as artificial intelligence, automation, blockchain, Internet of Things and as-a-service solutions are commercialized. ... Some of these technologies, such as cloud-based services, artificial intelligence and automation, and others that may emerge, have reduced and replaced some of our historical services and solutions and may continue to do so in the future.' At the same time it reports 'growing demand to assist clients with cloud enablement and the operation and maintenance of digital-related services'. The stock trades at 22.1x FY17E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of ACN's outsourcing specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $35.4B bookings in FY16; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 5.57x; +70% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.06; conservative 2yr -11%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY06-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.7%/yr (FY06-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2017-09-01) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 5.57x (42.4% downside to Bear $75 / +7.6% upside to Bull $140) | Adj composite 2.42 vs market 3.48: gap -1.06 [OVERVALUED] | +70% above the EPP floor $76 (13x FY17E $5.88) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.6% total (-5.3%/yr) | At 22.1x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $172 sits above the BULL case; consulting +6% LC in Q3, Q4 guided +5-8% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
